passage:
A country introduced electronic gates at airports. Travelers with approved passports could pass through quickly after face scanning.
Many people liked the shorter lines. But some travelers were still sent to human officers because the system could not read their faces correctly or their documents needed checking.
Airport workers explained that speed and security both mattered.
A student watching the process noticed that technology sorted people into different experiences. Some moved smoothly. Others waited longer.
The electronic gate seemed neutral, but it depended on data, design, and policy.
Borders are not only lines on maps. They are systems people pass through, sometimes easily and sometimes not.

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “A country introduced electronic gates at airports.”?

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The Digital Border: A country introduced electronic gates at airports.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The Grocery Scanner」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Old Border」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Digital Museum Guide」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
